title: Schedule of Annual Membership Fees, Personal Credit Cards
content:
The annual fee is the charge made once a year on the statement that closes in the account's anniversary month. Piedmont Crescent Bank sets it by tier, and by tier records whether the first account year is free of it.

| Tier | Annual fee | Fee not charged in the first account year |
|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 0.00 USD | no |
| College Rewards Visa | 0.00 USD | no |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 0.00 USD | no |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 0.00 USD | no |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 95.00 USD | yes |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 395.00 USD | no |

Four of the six tiers of Personal Credit Cards carry an annual fee of 0.00 USD. Of the two that charge one, Travel Rewards Visa Signature is the single tier whose first account year is free of the charge; Visa Infinite Private Client carries its 395.00 USD from the first anniversary-month statement onwards.

*Illustrative comparison.* A cardholder holding Travel Rewards Visa Signature and a cardholder holding Visa Infinite Private Client, both opened in the same month, meet different first-year charges: 0.00 USD on the first and 395.00 USD on the second, the 95.00 USD becoming payable on the second anniversary-month statement of the first.
